name: 猫箱
desc: ByteDance's AI character chat and roleplay app.
desc_zh: 字节跳动的 AI 角色聊天与角色扮演应用
solves: General assistants flatten personality into helpfulness. This one is built around characters you write and inhabit.
solves_zh: 通用助手会把人格压平成「有用」。这个产品是围绕你自己写、自己代入的角色建的。
best_for: You want character roleplay rather than task completion.
best_for_zh: 你想要的是角色扮演，而不是把任务做完。
